label: Observer-orbit preflight
title: When an observed cycle is not a source cycle
summary: On a six-cell Rule-30 ring, the one-step Groovy graph invents recurrent words: G=9 can follow itself once but cannot remain there. Valid three-row G histories and source identity have no phantom cycles through period six.
takeaway: Source-compatible cycles matter more than the observer graph alone; history costs two updates and three G reads. No feedback or Class-IV advantage tested.
